title: California 300
description: CA300-focused desert race park (~16 km). Built around the 2024 California 300 Race Ready course (~74 mi, nearly 1:1 fit) with pit row and danger-inspired g-outs, rocks, and washouts. Import heightmap_4096.png with squareSize=4 and maxHeight=900.
features: CA300 course, pit row, danger markers, open desert freeroam
roads: Packed desert race corridor with dirt berms; open freeroam desert around the course
